body:
Tested locally on Linux KDE X11 + NVIDIA (compositing enabled), it doesn't look the same as on the above video.

This appears to be related to the editor theme: it breaks when using **Black (OLED)**, but works with any other theme. Changing **Base Color** in the Editor Settings to `#010000` is enough to make it work; it just doesn't work if it's pure black (`#000000`).

**Make Floating Window Transparent** enabled:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae285bed-905b-4530-8660-ae26e9f99fce)

**Make Floating Window Transparent** disabled:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62fe730c-3f79-4ed5-948a-3d422ae2bd1f)

Per-pixel transparency and transparent viewport are both enabled in the Project Settings.
